name: auto-complete-monorepo
description: JetBrains + VS Code dual-host AI inline completion

scripts.build:js: npm run build:core-ts && npm run build:settings-ui && npm run build:vscode
scripts.test:js: npm run test:core-ts && npm run test:settings-ui
scripts.package:vscode: npm run build:settings-ui && npm run package -w auto-complete
